description: This file contains the implementation of key management endpoints for a FastAPI-based proxy server. It includes functions for generating, updating, and validating API keys, especially focusing on team and organization permissions, rate limits, object permissions, and auto-rotation features. The code manages key attributes, enforces limits, and handles enterprise and proxy-specific behaviors related to API key lifecycle management.
